limits.name: MAX_FRAME
limits.meaning: The largest page message (a frame): 32 768 bytes of padded plaintext, 2 of header, 16 of tag. Over it: TOO_LARGE.

limits.name: MAX_ROUTE
limits.meaning: The largest ROUTE message on the engine's socket: a frame plus its 18-byte header (version, type, sid). Over it: TOO_LARGE.

limits.name: MAX_CONTROL
limits.meaning: The largest control (text) message on the engine's socket. Over it: TOO_LARGE.

limits.name: MAX_EXPIRY_AHEAD
limits.meaning: How far ahead of now REGISTER_LINK may set expiresAt: 24 hours and 5 minutes. Later: ERROR INVALID_EXPIRY.

limits.name: CHALLENGE_TTL
limits.meaning: How long the Vault's CHALLENGE stays valid; a later AUTH closes with AUTH_FAILED.

limits.name: MIN_LINKS_PER_ENGINE
limits.meaning: The fewest live links the Vault accepts per engine; over the Vault's own number: ERROR LINK_LIMIT.

limits.name: MAX_SESSIONS_PER_LINK
limits.meaning: The most open sessions one link may have. Over it: SESSION_LIMIT.

limits.name: MAX_SESSIONS_PER_ENGINE
limits.meaning: The most open sessions one engine may have. Over it: SESSION_LIMIT.

limits.name: MAX_HANDSHAKES_PER_LINK
limits.meaning: The most handshakes (message 1s) one link token may start within HANDSHAKE_WINDOW. Over it: RATE_LIMITED.

limits.name: HANDSHAKE_WINDOW
limits.meaning: The window MAX_HANDSHAKES_PER_LINK counts over: 10 minutes.
